primary_phase_timing: Only frozen bench.py B-C-B results. Fixed-N phase probes do not imply full native training speedup.

native_workload_seconds.includes: Fresh native Python child initialization, complete original 30000-step training, every native evaluation/checkpoint/PLY/GUI event, and wrapper setup before the postcheck subprocess.
native_workload_seconds.excludes: Out-of-band CPU artifact validation after native training. Its duration is retained separately.
native_workload_seconds.data_source: Existing timestamps written by frozen full_train.py and native_entry.py bounded_run; no replacement timing script.
native_workload_seconds.eligibility: Both paired full_train.json status complete and returncode zero; both native_complete.json contain successful fresh CPU postcheck with empty CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES; exact frozen source/data/config/seed/schedule bindings; source-specific GPU isolation limitation remains.
native_workload_seconds.missing_boundary: UNAVAILABLE. Do not substitute log timestamps, progress-bar elapsed values, recovered receipts or inferred durations.
native_workload_seconds.known_baseline_eligibility_before_optimi: Seed0 baseline bonsai used the legacy postcheck, and seed0 bicycle/garden retain failed original exits with strict separate postcheck recovery. These three are ineligible for paired native performance; seed1 runs use the fixed fresh-CPU wrapper for all scenes.

wrapper_child_seconds: full_train.process.ended_unix - full_train.process.started_unix; includes artifact validation and is diagnostic only, not reported as native training acceleration.
quality: Evaluate both matched seeds 0/1 at native 7k and 30k, all held-out cameras, frozen baseline PSNR/SSIM/L1. Strictly recovered seed0 models remain eligible for quality only with their explicit immutable proof.
statistical_claims: Two quality seeds are descriptive. Shared GPU timings are exploratory. No formal ResearchBoost PASS or statistical full-training equivalence claim.
